--- text
alpha be|ta

gamma delta
--- keys
Down Down
--- expect
alpha beta

gamma de|lta
--- note
Line 2 is empty: two consecutive newlines. The caret starts at column 8 of line 1. The first Down cannot hold column 8 on a zero-length line, so it clamps to column 0 there, but it must not discard the goal column. The second Down then restores column 8 on line 3. An empty line is the extreme short line and must carry the goal column through just as a longer short line does (see caret/05, caret/06).
